prerequisites: This subject can only be taken if the second study section has been reached. For this, at least 42 ECTS credits from the first study section must be demonstrated.
It is recommended that students already have an idea of the topic for their own Bachelor's thesis.

learning_outcomes.text: describe the different possibilities of publishing
select suitable methods for information retrieval
systematically and target-orientedly conduct information retrieval
use different information systems for literature search
apply relevant citation rules and create a corresponding bibliography
use tools to manage literature sources and create bibliographies

syllabus_topics: Process of systematic and target-oriented research
The most important instruments for the subject area: library catalogs, interlibrary loan, scientific subject databases, standards and patents

assessment_methods.method: Seminar paper (10-20 pages) without oral presentation

assessment_rules: The assessment consists of 4 tasks to be completed during the semester and submitted in written form as a seminar paper at the end of the seminar. To pass the module, more than half of the achievable total points are required.
